### Capium Pay: How to Create a Vendor

			Print

	Modified on: Thu, 30 Mar, 2023 at  4:59 PM

		Navigation >>> Bookkeeping>>> Capium Pay

Step 1: Vendor Registration:

Once you click ‘Get started’ on the Capium Pay welcome page, you’ll be navigated to the Capium Pay Vendor Details screen- please fill in the relevant Vendor details below:

Once vendor details are entered, this will then trigger the payment portal to open & you will be sent an onboarding invite email.

Please immediately map the appropriate bank account from Capium that you would want to withdraw funds to. It's important to do this step so you don’t run into reconciliation issues at year end. 

(Settings>>> Map Bank account>>> Choose from list & then save)

Please Note: If the bank account that you want to collect the money is not currently added on Capium, you’ll need to add a bank account manually under ‘Bank’. Once added, you can come back to this section and now map the account to Capium Pay.

title:
What onboarding documents are required?
	 	
			
			Print
cleanText:
Solution home 
		Capium Pay
		FAQ

### What onboarding documents are required?

			Print

	Modified on: Thu, 6 Apr, 2023 at  8:15 AM

		Required Documents for Directors/UBOs 

We require a copy of a passport/Driving Licence and proof of current home address for each Director and UBO. 

Directors 

We require documents for all Directors currently listed as active on Companies House. 

Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) 

Any person who is listed as a person with significant control on Companies House. If another company is listed as a person with significant control then we will require details of the UBOs for that company as well. 

Settlement Bank Account 

This is the bank account that funds will be paid into. It must be a business account held in the name of the company. 

Bank Statement or Voided Cheque 

This is for proof of settlement bank account – it should be a statement or voided cheque for the bank account that funds will be paid into. 

Proof of Address 

We require a utility bill, tax statement etc. for the company to confirm the operational address. 

Authorised Signatory 

If the Representative is not a Director then we will require a letter signed by one of the company Directors stating that the representative is authorized to sign on behalf of the company. 

Business URL 

We require a link to the company website or business page. If the company does not have either of these we will contact them to clarify their market and business model.

title:
My onboarding link doesn’t work, what should I do?
	 	
			
			Print
cleanText:
Solution home 
		Capium Pay
		FAQ

### My onboarding link doesn’t work, what should I do?

			Print

	Modified on: Thu, 6 Apr, 2023 at  8:15 AM

		The onboarding link expired 24hrs after it was generated. In addition to this, the vendor will only be able to reopen a link with the same device they opened it with the first time. The vendor can refresh their onboarding link with no external help needed via his onboarding.

For example, if the link was first opened with device ‘A’ and it is attempted to be opened later with device ‘B’, the link will be expired. When the vendor refreshes the link, it can be again initially opened from any device.

Why my card payment was declined? Print

Modified on: Thu, 6 Apr, 2023 at 8:15 AM

The card issuer determines to approve or decline a card transaction based on their validations and checks. When a transaction is declined, the reason should be provided in the response. The decline reason should also be specified in the UNIPaaS portal on the “All Payments” page.
